_comment: Example tutorial spec. Times are recording seconds; coordinates are in 1080x2400 recording pixels (any phone recording is scaled to that first). See tools/tutorial/README.md.
title: Sign up in *one minute*
subtitle: Create your account

steps.vo: Let's see how to sign up for YourBrand in under a minute.

steps.title: Open sign up
steps.vo: Open the app and tap Sign Up at the bottom.

steps.title: Verify your number
steps.vo: Type your phone number and tap Verify. You'll get a code by SMS.

note.text: Never share this code with anyone

steps.title: You're *ready!*
steps.vo: That's it! Start using YourBrand today.
